title: Two visual designs, the same posting flow
question: Choose the look you prefer. Both retain Choose → write → review, independent destination results, on-device drafts, and Instagram's manual finish. These are static mockups only.

options.label: A · Soft Plum
options.thesis: Warm, spacious and gently grouped; a refinement of the first design.
options.viewport: A labeled stage strip, a calm shared editor, ordered media, and softly grouped platform versions.
options.risk: The rounded tonal groups may feel too soft if you prefer a plain utility.

options.label: B · Clear Blue
options.thesis: Bright, precise and easier to scan; a flatter alternative with stronger hierarchy.
options.viewport: A compact stage line, an open writing field, ordered media, and a single list of platform versions.
options.risk: The sharper, flatter treatment feels more utilitarian.
